stories.title: 'We've released our debut album - nearly 40 years after it was recorded'
stories.summary: The Catburgers will finally perform songs from their album Galashiels in the town it was named after.

stories.title: NHS Grampian publishes leaked report at centre of hospital scandal
stories.summary: The report was leaked last week by a surgeon who called for NHS Grampian to face a corporate homicide investigation.

stories.title: Man charged over sexual assault claims at school in historical abuse probe
stories.summary: The person, who cannot be named for legal reasons, was charged in September as a part of Operation Dewdrop which is focused on Loretto School in Musselburgh.

stories.title: Sheriff calls for better communication over the risks of farmers falling from heights
stories.summary: Deaths in Aberdeenshire, Stirling, Mull, the Borders and Stewarton were the focus of the inquiry.

stories.title: Two jailed for attacking man with machete and knife in Glasgow
stories.summary: Michael Frati and Paul Connor were sentenced at the High Court in Edinburgh for the machette attack in Shettleston on 13 March that year.

stories.title: Body found in woodland confirmed as missing Kelsey Hunter
stories.summary: Kelsey Hunter's body was found in a wooded area near the village of Springholm where she lived.

stories.title: Scot extradited from Dubai charged with organised crime offences
stories.summary: Alan Thomson, who was arrested in Dubai, is accused of running a drugs operation in Glasgow and Greater Manchester.

stories.title: Man, 87, who died after being hit by car was a 'much-loved grandfather'
stories.summary: Douglas Agnew was described by his family as a "much-loved father, grandfather and friend".

stories.title: Scotcast: Should kids be allowed in the pub?
stories.summary: A proposal to let unaccompanied 12-15-year-olds into some venues was dropped.

stories.title: Drivers urged not to risk ignoring diversion for landslip work
stories.summary: Drivers are asked not to try to move barriers put on the "extremely dangerous" route near Sanquhar.

stories.title: Your pictures of Scotland
stories.summary: A selection of photographs submitted to BBC Scotland News from around the country this week.

stories.title: Rapist jailed after secretly recorded cafe confession
stories.summary: A jury found 36-year-old David Smyth guilty of raping his victim while she slept at a property in Falkirk.
